tools.name: check_if_wordpress
tools.title: Is it WordPress?
tools.description: Check whether a website is built with WordPress. Returns a yes/no verdict, a confidence level, which of the eight detection signals matched, and the active theme when one is identifiable.

url.description: The website to analyze. A bare domain works — "wordpress.org" and "https://wordpress.org/" behave the same.

tools.name: get_wordpress_tech_stack
tools.title: Tech stack report
tools.description: Get the full tech stack behind a website: WordPress theme, active plugins, hosting provider, CDN, web server, security headers, and page speed measurements. The broadest of these tools — prefer it when the question is open-ended ("what is this site built with?").

url.description: The website to analyze. A bare domain works — "wordpress.org" and "https://wordpress.org/" behave the same.

tools.name: detect_website_fonts
tools.title: Font detector
tools.description: List every font a website uses: families with weights and styles, the provider each comes from (Google Fonts, Bunny, Fontshare, Adobe kits, self-hosted @font-face), system font stacks, WordPress theme.json font presets, and the CSS type scale. Works on non-WordPress sites too.

url.description: The website to analyze. A bare domain works — "stripe.com" and "https://stripe.com/" behave the same.

tools.name: extract_color_palette
tools.title: Color palette extractor
tools.description: Extract a website's color palette from its CSS: every color with hex, rgb and hsl, which color plays which role (background, text, primary, accent, border), the WordPress theme.json palette, gradients, and WCAG contrast pairs. Works on non-WordPress sites too.

url.description: The website to analyze. A bare domain works — "stripe.com" and "https://stripe.com/" behave the same.
